title: STELLAR: A Search-Based Testing Framework for Large Language Model Applications
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmarks, SafeQA and NaviQA, measure system safety against malicious prompts (e.g., instructions for illegal actions) and functional correctness for navigational venue recommendations, respectively.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
